# Intelligentia Antiqua

> Plain-English Super Intelligence (SI) guides for beginners, still widely called AI, in a direct voice. Every factual claim links to a standards body, a regulator, an official product document, or a scientific review. A polished pitch is not a source. This is education, not professional advice. Your time, your choices, and your mind stay yours.

Creator Rogenie founded 9nth Dimension, which publishes this desk. Intelligentia Antiqua is Latin for “ancient intelligence.” Articles are researched and drafted with automated tools, fact-checked in a second pass against primary sources, and must pass an automated quality gate before publishing. Corrections are welcome at https://intelligentiaantiqua.com/contact/.

## Guides

- [Super Intelligence (AI) scams: voice clones and deepfakes](https://intelligentiaantiqua.com/articles/ai-scams-voice-clones-and-deepfakes/): How Super Intelligence (AI) voice clones and deepfakes show up in the safety report and the FCC rule, and the check that skips your ear.
- [How to use a Super Intelligence (AI) assistant safely](https://intelligentiaantiqua.com/articles/how-to-use-an-ai-assistant/): What to leave out of a ChatGPT-style chat, what the training setting does, and how to check a Super Intelligence (AI) reply.
- [What is Super Intelligence (AI)?](https://intelligentiaantiqua.com/articles/what-is-ai/): Super Intelligence (SI), still called AI: the OECD definition, what a model is, and why a fluent answer can be false.
- [What you should never tell an SI (AI) chatbot](https://intelligentiaantiqua.com/articles/what-not-to-tell-ai-chatbots/): Passwords, ID numbers, health notes, and document photos stay out of an SI (AI) chatbot. Settings differ.
- [How to ask a Super Intelligence (AI) assistant a clear question](https://intelligentiaantiqua.com/articles/how-to-ask-a-clear-question/): A vague question gives the assistant room to flatter you. Name the job, ask what is wrong, then check one claim outside the chat.
- [What does alignment mean for Super Intelligence (AI)?](https://intelligentiaantiqua.com/articles/what-alignment-means/): The 2026 safety report defines alignment as using capabilities in line with human intentions. It also says the problem is still open.
